title: Informant
caption: Informant (V)
game_text: ▼ Undercover. OR Peek at top X cards of opponent’s Reserve Deck, where X = number of opponent’s characters present with your Undercover spy. OR If your Undercover spy on table, peek at top card of your Reserve Deck.
lore: The Empire's network of spies and petty informants allows Imperial operatives to discover and react to Rebel assaults before they occur.
